title: What is the best lap time recorded? List the driver and race with such reco
question:
What is the best lap time recorded? List the driver and race with such recorded lap time.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: the best lap time refers to min(milliseconds); List the driver refers to drivers.forename and drivers.surname; List the race refers to races.name

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
    d.XCL_037 AS driver,
    r.XCL_069 AS race,
    lt.XCL_047 AS best_lap_time
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.XCL_044 = d.XCL_034
JOIN races r ON lt.XCL_043 = r.XCL_065
WHERE lt.XCL_047 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    CAST(SUBSTR(lt.XCL_047, 1, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER),
    CAST(SUBSTR(lt.XCL_047, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, ':') + 1, INSTR(SUBSTR(lt.XCL_047, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, ':') + 1), '.') - 1) AS INTEGER),
    CAST(SUBSTR(lt.XCL_047, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, '.') + 1) AS REAL)
LIMIT 1
